description:
We are actively hiring AI scientists to take part in designing, building, and operating fault tolerant neutral atom quantum computers. You will work in a tight-knit team, and will be responsible for researching and developing AI systems that automate our scientific research and quantum computer design. Prior knowledge of quantum computing is not required. Frontier research experience in artificial intelligence is strongly desirable for this role. We are hiring at all experience levels, including post-bachelors, masters, PhD, and beyond.



Requirements:

 - Wants to build a quantum computer

 - Works well in a highly collaborative team environment



Compensation:

 - $200,000-$350,000/year depending on experience

 - Benefits (health and dental coverage, 401K, unlimited PTO, paid family leave, visa sponsorship)

 - Equity



Oratomic is an equal opportunity employer. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application process, contact info@oratomic.com.
